en.description:
Turn screen time into learning time! WristWiz transforms your Apple Watch into a pocket-sized classroom with 8 engaging games designed for curious minds.

LEARN WHILE YOU PLAY

Rocket Math
Blast off through the solar system! Answer multiplication problems to fuel your rocket and visit all 8 planets. Each correct answer brings you closer to Neptune, with fun planet facts along the way.

Angle Hunter
Master geometry using the Digital Crown! Rotate to match angles, identify acute vs obtuse, and build spatial intuition. A unique watch experience that makes math tangible.

Fraction Frenzy
See fractions come alive with colorful pizza slices and pie charts. Tap to fill portions, compare fractions, and develop number sense through visual puzzles.

Speed Scientist
Swipe through rapid-fire science questions! From "Is the Sun a star?" to fascinating facts about animals, weather, and the human body. Build knowledge one swipe at a time.

THINK STRATEGICALLY

Mini Chess - Full chess strategy on a 5×5 board
Checkers - Classic gameplay, perfectly sized
Tic-Tac-Toe - Quick matches, timeless fun

CHALLENGE YOUR BRAIN

2048 - The addictive number puzzle that never gets old

WHY WRISTWIZ?

• Perfect for ages 8-12 (and adults too!)
• Quick sessions: 30 seconds to 2 minutes
• No WiFi needed - play anywhere
• Progress saves automatically
• High scores to beat
• No ads. No in-app purchases. Ever.

IDEAL FOR

• Waiting rooms & car rides
• Quick brain breaks between activities
• Building math confidence
• Screen-free entertainment (it's on your wrist!)
• Family game time

Download WristWiz and discover that learning fits perfectly on your wrist.
en.subtitle: Math, Science & Brain Games
